items.title: Deebo Samuel: Five touches in Week 11
items.text:
Samuel logged two carries for 27 yards, gathered in three of four targets for 20 yards and returned two kickoffs for 57 yards during Sunday's 35-10 win against the Vikings in Mexico City.

items.title: Jordan Mason: Team's leading rusher in lopsided loss
items.text:
Mason rushed 11 times for 38 yards while catching his lone target for minus-1 yard in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the 49ers.

items.title: Aaron Jones: Quiet after first-quarter TD
items.text:
Jones rushed eight times for 30 yards and a touchdown while catching his lone target for 13 yards in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the 49ers.

items.title: T.J. Hockenson: Six receptions in return
items.text:
Hockenson (wrist) caught six of seven targets for 55 yards in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the 49ers.

items.title: Kirk Cousins: Stymied by 49ers again
items.text:
Cousins completed 26 of 38 passes for 235 yards, no touchdowns and one interception in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the 49ers. He also rushed once for no gain.
